meta.g: Original blue and lime character animation
meta.d: Play action frames 0-240 once, then loop idle frames 240-480. Blue has soft rounded fixed-length arms with transparent roots on the lower sides of the body. Both arms are down while talking. During the jump, the right arm rises and touches the armless lime head, then both arms return down. After landing both smile, float gently and blink occasionally at different times. Lime hem waves continuously. All image assets embedded. Both blue arm image layers are scaled uniformly to 80% of their prior dimensions; the blue jump crest is offset slightly to preserve exact hand-to-head contact.
